HIPAA-adjacent requirement: currently not a covered entity but product collects some PHI-like fields (med conditions, meds). CTO: 'need to avoid risk — retention 30 days max and ability to purge on request'.
Latency target: <200ms p95 for interactive chat; embeddings search latency not critical (500-1000ms ok).

Model preferences: start with open LLM (Llama-like) for chat; embeddings for semantic search (sentence-transformer type). Want automatic fallback to smaller model when limited capacity.
Security: SSO/SAML for admin access, KMS for key wrap, audit logs for request-level tracing. Also wants clear docs on data handling in hosted offering (do tokens persist? where? retention controls?).
Quote from CTO: 'We want to try without heavy procurement — self-serve is ideal, but compliance questions will decide if we proceed.'
AE notes: good fit for Hosted API POC. Recommend sending security-faq and 30-day retention policy example. Offer to demo console and token-level cost view.
Tactical: demo planned after FAQ send; SE (Maya) to outline minimal POC config (model, prompt templates, embedding index).
Potential upsell: later migrate to Dedicated if usage grows or if there's a compliance mandate requiring private deployment.
